issue.title: Schema editors that arrange instantly and pick emoji beautifully
issue.description: The album Schema Card and the Bank setup card move fields, choices, categories, groups, and rules any distance with an instant local preview, then save the whole arrangement as one guarded bob transaction with one commit and one Undo. Every emoji prompt is a searchable Emoji Slot. Both cards use a calmer, contextual layout. Bob stays the only writer, and nothing is saved without a successful preview of the exact envelope.
